notes:
November 28th 2026
Version 13.18.21 (stable) / 13.19.21 (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Fixed an issue when shutting down or restarting the Mac with K-Configurator open. (K,R)
* Score Editor: import a MIDI file as a score. (K,R)
* Live Scoring: fast runs and grace notes stay on the beat. (K,R)
* K-Editor (beta users): matches the FISA screen: values, units and names. (K)
* K-Editor (beta users): accented register names now load on the FISA. (K)
* K-Editor (beta users): scale presets set every note, as on the panel. (K)
* Easier clicks on small number boxes. (K,R)
* Reminder when SET edits are not saved yet. (R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
notes_beta:
November 28th 2026
Version 13.18.22 (stable) / 13.19.22 (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* SET File Editor: register names update after every Apply. (R)
* SET File Editor: "discard your changes" in Import Register now really discards. (R)
* Export / Import Single Set opens in the folder you last used on the stick. (K,R)
* Live Editor: the Write/Save button now says exactly what it will save. (R)
* K-Editor (beta users): register names update after Apply, and drum, reed and left-hand settings follow the FISA's own rules. (K)
* Score Editor: Import MIDI File fits small screens; quick legato runs no longer stack notes. (K,R)
* Fixed an issue when quitting while an update was offered. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
